name: Kettlebell Overhead Press
description: Standing, press the kettlebell from your shoulder to straight overhead, then lower it back to your shoulder.

source.title: Overhead Press (ACE Exercise Library)
source.note: The standing single-arm kettlebell version, described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Hold the bell at your shoulder, handle in your palm, the bell against your forearm.
cues: Squeeze your glutes and stomach; no leaning back.
Press straight up, biceps by your ear.

prescription.note: Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower. Start with a light bell.

keyframes.name: Bell at your shoulder
keyframes.cue: Bell resting at your shoulder, elbow tucked in front.

keyframes.name: Press
keyframes.cue: Press the bell straight up until your arm is straight.
